create.name: Light Watkins
create.bio:
Light Watkins grew up in Montgomery, Alabama, and spent his twenties moving between an advertising job in Chicago and modelling work in New York before a yoga class led him, somewhat reluctantly, to meditation. After relocating to Los Angeles to teach yoga full time, he met a Vedic Meditation teacher in 2003, later travelled to India to train as a meditation teacher himself, and has kept a daily seated practice ever since.

His teaching is deliberately down to earth: short daily sits, little fuss about technique, and a focus on bringing presence into ordinary decisions, relationships and work. He has written five books, among them Bliss More, The Inner Gym, Knowing Where to Look, Travel Light and The Year You Transform, and his TEDxVeniceBeach talk on common misunderstandings about meditation has drawn close to a million views. From 2018 he spent five years living out of a single backpack, an experiment that shaped his ideas about simple, values-led living. Today he gives keynotes on presence to organisations, offers private one-to-one coaching, writes a weekly letter on Substack, and teaches a 21-day meditation course on Commune.

books.title: Bliss More: How to Succeed in Meditation Without Really Trying
books.author: Light Watkins
books.description: Light's first book and the one most associated with his teaching. It sets out an easy-going approach to sitting every day, takes apart the usual worries about doing it wrong, and is written for complete beginners as well as lapsed meditators.

books.title: The Inner Gym: A Simple Workout For Strengthening Happiness
books.author: Light Watkins
books.description: A month-long programme of short readings and daily exercises, framed as training for the inner life. Each chapter pairs a personal story with a small practice aimed at contentment and steadier habits.

books.title: Knowing Where to Look: 108 Daily Doses of Inspiration
books.author: Light Watkins
books.description: A collection of 108 brief stories and reflections, each closing with a prompt or exercise. It is meant to be dipped into one piece a day, as a nudge towards intuition and creative living.

books.title: Travel Light: Spiritual Minimalism to Live a More Fulfilled Life
books.author: Light Watkins
books.description: Drawing on the years he lived from one backpack, Light describes what he calls spiritual minimalism: letting go of excess possessions, commitments and habits of mind so that choices follow one's values. Chapters mix travel stories with practical principles.

books.title: The Year You Transform: The Quickest Path to Changing Your Life for the Better
books.author: Light Watkins
books.description: His most recent book argues for slow, steady change over dramatic overhauls. It offers a year of small weekly challenges designed to build momentum one modest step at a time.

courses.title: 21-Day Meditation Challenge
courses.description: A three-week video course on Commune for building a daily sitting habit. Each day has a short talk from Light followed by a guided sit of around eight minutes, with reflection prompts to carry the practice into the rest of the day.

courses.title: The Reset Roadmap: 1-on-1 Coaching
courses.description: Private coaching with Light for people in leadership or creative roles who want more presence in a busy life. It combines personal sessions, meditation and stillness training online or in person, and support between meetings; entry is by application.
